name: verify-completion
description: Require evidence-backed verification before completion claims.

interface.shortDescription: Require evidence-backed verification before completion claims.
interface.longDescription: A skills-only verification protocol for completion, correctness, handoff, commit, and pull-request claims. It requires applicable adversarial review, outcome validation, counterpart enforcement, false-positive analysis, positive and negative proof, and independently reviewable evidence. The protocol never grants new authority or bypasses project controls.
defaultPrompt: Use $verify-completion to verify the applicable gates before I claim this work is complete.
